Our legacy

A Journey Built on the Belief That Every Child Can Thrive.

Tungal's story is one of commitment to accessible education, strong values and the belief that opportunity can change lives. From its roots in Jamkhandi, the institution has grown to serve learners across multiple locations.

As the institution celebrates its 25-year milestone, the next chapter is about preparing young people with the knowledge, confidence and character to shape the future.

✦Quality & accessible education
✦Merit and opportunity
✦Values-led learning
✦Holistic development

Founder · Driving force

Mr. Ashok Tungal

A passionate visionary from Jamkhandi, Mr. Ashok Tungal stands as the driving force behind Tungal Institutions, guiding its mission to deliver quality education with commitment, care and at an affordable cost.

02
Leadership · Healthcare & academics

Mrs. Laxmi Tungal

A dedicated doctor, Mrs. Laxmi Tungal has a fierce and inspiring spirit that shines through her gynaecology practice, cultural traits and academic pursuits, which she manages with equal enthusiasm and excellence.
